rationale: Build on the current best reverse-tail recurrence curriculum instead of another small scalar sweep. This keeps the strong decoder-output anchor path intact, but adds a learned per-tail-block anchor refresh gate so the anchor can update only when useful. It is a compact, compile-stable structural edit that starts from the prior behavior at initialization, preserves the existing exact int8+zlib evaluation path, and spends only a small number of extra control parameters on the recurrent tail where local results remain strongest.
title: Gated Tail-Anchor Refresh
